title: GET https://api-ar-game.bistudio.com/game-api/api/v1.0/world?platformId=<platformId>&clientVersion=<clientVersion>
$comment: Observed on 1.8.0.13 as the second call of the server's startup, four times: 200, 401 bytes. It returns one named block of game data - `BanSettings`, which is the version string the heartbeat answer echoes back as currentWorldVersion. The block is the crime and ban tuning the server then applies, and m_fAccelerationMin: 1 is the same value the profile document quotes as a constant from SCR_PlayerDataConfigs.c.

version.description: Which block of game data this is. The enum lists what was observed; the endpoint is a general `world` endpoint, so other blocks presumably exist and would take other versions.

m_sDesc.description: Observed: `Ban Logic Cleansweep` - a description of the ruleset, shown nowhere the captures reach.

m_BanSettings.description: Eleven numbers with the m_ Hungarian prefixes of the script classes. The names are the specification; the values are the live ones on the day of the capture.

m_fScoreThreshold.description: 10.0 in the capture - the criminal score at which the heavy evaluation starts.

m_fAccelerationMin.description: 1.0 - the value docs/en/ArmaReforger_Profile_EN.md section 5 quotes as a constant from SCR_PlayerDataConfigs.c, which is what the game falls back to.

m_fBanEvaluationHeavy.description: 1.0 - the threshold of the `heavy ban (requires backendapi ban)` branch in SCR_DataCollectorCrimesModule.

m_fCrimePtFriendKill.description: 1.0 crime point for a friendly kill.

m_fCrimePtTeamKill.description: 0.7 for a team kill, so the two are weighted differently.

m_bVotingSuggestionEnabled.description: 0 in the capture. Sent as a number where a bool would be expected - the same m_b...-prefixed-as-number convention the server.json gameProperties use.
